_comment: Visual knobs shared by the notebook figures AND the widgets (both import src.viz, which reads this file at import time). Edit a value, then re-run: python scripts/build_notebook.py && jupyter nbconvert --execute ... && python scripts/bake_widgets.py
_soft_cmap_help: Colormap for soft/consensus maps. High consensus = dark end. Try 'plasma_r' or 'viridis_r' for a coloured (less black) dark end; 'magma_r' is the darkest.
_soft_gamma_help: Exponent of the value->opacity ramp. Lower (e.g. 0.5) makes mid consensus more opaque; higher fades it.
_soft_max_alpha_help: Cap on the soft-map opacity at full consensus (1.0 = fully opaque/darkest, lets no image through; 0.8 keeps a little image texture visible so peak consensus is not a pure black block).
_fill_alpha_help: Opacity of the translucent per-rater fills.
_rater_contour_px_help: Width, in native pixels, of the solid rater contours (fills+contours overlay and widget rater layers). 1 = thinnest.
_hard_contour_lw_help: Line width (matplotlib points) of the white hard-consensus contour drawn by ax.contour.
